title: Astro Portal session event payload: device_connected
description: The application opened its own link to a smart telescope in mode expérimental (the link a mount does not share). Read only: connecting never moves or commands the device. A smart telescope in mode simplifié is driven through the mount link and writes the `mount_*` events instead. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

family.description: Optional: the smart telescope's family (`seestar`, `dwarf`, `vespera`, `origin`) when the device is one.

model.description: Optional: the model the device reported.
